supplemental_items.interpretation: Signature contains First, Break, mode, optional intrabar_start, top source index/string price, bottom source index/string price, optional anchor index/string value. No numeric normalization or int conversion, no behavior flags or full object equality. Native hashability required by consuming set/key.

supplemental_items.interpretation: Trend then opposite reaction list, zero-based ordinal; dependency time is main open at native Break index, not confirmation. Add Reset event + integer owner First, first Reset Blue event + ordinal, public Blue event. Set collapses duplicates; additions/removals compared later. Does not include full A or every Blue field; no arbitrary revision safety inferred.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Type3/4 returns decision event without Order or lower-row check. Otherwise assert Order, lower_bound(max(confirmation,range_start)); position=end or first row after through => null. This checks existence of row in gate..decision inclusive, not strict stop/candidate crossing or range_end. Max with Order Break open; S15 first later trend match (even if actual selected route Advanced/pre), if nonnull max its Break open and returned confirmation.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Dirty bound inclusive [0,count], no exact integer validation. Scope direction,TF,start index,range start (no end or input identity). Dirty current main open or range_end when at count. Current dependencies computed before scope comparison. Equal scope computes earliest symmetric difference event with default dirty then min; else empty previous. Fresh current map.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, state mutation, provenance, cache/failure boundary or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Order key null or (ordinal,S44,confirmation), then A key ordinal,source index,source time,str(price),full stop tuple,Order key. Previous only lookup (not current), strict through<dirty reuses same pair and S reference. Equality recomputes. Other fields omitted by design of native key; W2 must establish caller dependency coverage.

supplemental_items.interpretation: Detector S42 still clears and rebuilds audit/ownership even on cache hits.
